name: The Pyrewood Armorer drops Overcooked Chain Links for Oh, the Places You'll Go
contract: Hardcore - Oh, the Places You'll Go (611) requires looting Overcooked Chain Links 421531 before level 15 (LOOT_ITEM_BEFORE_LEVEL 1/421531/15).
The item had no item_template row and no loot entry, so it could never drop and the objective could not be completed.

Expected (Conquest of Azeroth item cache, Exiles DB mirror of db.exil.es): Pyrewood Armorer 3528 drops it at 100%, and looting it below level 15 completes the objective, which the module reports with SMSG_COA_CHALLENGE_CRITERIA_UPDATED (0x59A): word 1 the challenge, word 5 the objective's item, word 6 its progress.
A level 1 character on the trial kills a 1-health Armorer fixture, finds the item in the corpse, loots it into its bags and receives the completed criterion for 611 and 421531.
